scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a brief chance to add a no-cost seated mobility add-on to an already planned aquatics outing.
Emerging Need: A vague program note becomes a specific last-mat opening only after the topic, timing, and accessible transition are visible.
Decision Context: Arden’s saved exercise preference distinguishes worthwhile add-ons from generic classes and limits any outreach to a reviewable draft; calendar and center messages establish fit.
Consequence: Acting during the narrow window could add useful movement ideas to Arden’s routine, while ignoring it leaves the aquatics plan unchanged; after release, the extra session is unavailable.

parameter.title: Gentle aquatics class
parameter.description: Low-impact community center class already on Arden's summer exercise rotation.

parameter.subject: Possible add-on after Thursday aquatics
parameter.body: The wellness desk may add a short no-cost movement mini-session after Thursday evening aquatics if studio staffing is finalized. Topic and sign-up details are still pending.

parameter.sender: East Portland Community Center Aquatics Desk
parameter.content: For Thursday, aquatics check-in will also cover the adjacent accessible studio if a mini-session is added. Staff can direct participants from the pool exit to the studio without a second public entrance line.

parameter.subject: One no-cost mat open: seated shoulder mobility after aquatics
parameter.body: Staff confirmed a 6:25 PM to 6:50 PM chair-based shoulder mobility mini-session in Studio B after Thursday aquatics. One observer mat is open for an already checked-in aquatics participant. The reservation window closes at 4:00 PM today; unclaimed mats then go to walk-ins.

parameter.subject: Thursday shoulder mobility mats are full
parameter.body: All observer mats for Thursday's seated shoulder mobility mini-session have now been assigned. No additional spots are available for this week's add-on.
